parameters.query:
SELECT 
  string_agg(
    '• [' || UPPER(rule_type) || ' - ' || UPPER(rule_category) || '] ' || rule_name || ': ' || rule_statement, 
    E'\n'
  ) AS skill_rules
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (rule_name) 
    rule_type, rule_category, rule_name, rule_statement, confidence_score
  FROM social_content_rulebook
  WHERE account_name = 'bajajfinance'
    AND platform = 'instagram'
    AND status = 'approved'
    AND active = TRUE
  ORDER BY rule_name, confidence_score DESC
) sub;

parameters.promptTemplate:
You are an Instagram performance analyst. Extract and evaluate ONLY the posts published on T-2 (48 hours ago / 6 September 2026). Output 4 concise sections:
1. What Worked (Hook, format, saves)
2. What Did Not Work
3. Root-Cause Analysis (Why it happened)
4. Strategic Adjustments for upcoming content

You are an expert Instagram content strategist for @bajajfinance. Brainstorm exactly 10 highly engaging, specific content topics (4 Short-form Reels, 4 Educational Carousels, 2 Single-image Infographics) addressing consumer personal loan pain points and fraud safety.

workflows.name: Feedback
workflows.description: Strategy governance engine for @bajajfinance Instagram content: Inbound critique webhook, current active SQL rules, Gemini strategy formulator, and PostgreSQL automated rulebook upsert.

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  string_agg(
    format('• [%s - %s] %s: %s', upper(rule_type), upper(rule_category), rule_name, rule_statement), 
    E'\n' ORDER BY rule_id
  ) AS skill_rules
FROM social_content_rulebook
WHERE account_name = 'bajajfinance' 
  AND platform = 'instagram' 
  AND active = TRUE;

parameters.promptTemplate:
You are the strategy governance engine for @bajajfinance's Instagram content.
The creative team rejected or critiqued a proposed content plan with this feedback:
"{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.feedback }}"

CURRENT ACTIVE RULES:
{{ $('Execute a SQL query').first().json.skill_rules }}

TASK:
Analyze the critique. Formulate a specific, actionable rule that prevents this mistake in future content generation.

parameters.query:
WITH raw_data AS (
  SELECT '{{ $json.content.parts[0].text.replace(/'/g, "''").trim() }}' AS raw_text
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT 
    raw_text::json->>'rule_name'        AS rule_name,
    raw_text::json->>'rule_statement'   AS rule_statement,
    raw_text::json->>'rule_category'    AS rule_category,
    raw_text::json->>'rule_type'        AS rule_type,
    raw_text::json->>'observation'      AS observation,
    (raw_text::json->>'confidence_score')::numeric AS confidence_score
  FROM raw_data
),
upsert_rule AS (
  INSERT INTO social_content_rulebook (
    account_name, platform, rule_name, rule_statement, 
    rule_category, rule_type, status, active, confidence_score
  )
  SELECT 
    'bajajfinance', 'instagram', rule_name, rule_statement,
    rule_category, rule_type, 'approved', TRUE, confidence_score
  FROM parsed
  ON CONFLICT (account_name, platform, rule_name) DO UPDATE
    SET rule_statement   = EXCLUDED.rule_statement,
        confidence_score = EXCLUDED.confidence_score,
        updated_at       = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  RETURNING rule_id
)
INSERT INTO social_rule_evidence (
  rule_id, account_name, platform, evidence_type, raw_critique
)
SELECT 
  ur.rule_id, 'bajajfinance', 'instagram', 'human_critique',
  p.observation
FROM upsert_rule ur, parsed p;
